answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1852 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vertex. The velvet index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the falcon queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Each impostor pays 10 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
